turns.question: Are Pending Receivals already counted as available on-hand inventory? How do I record a partial delivery?

response.message:
No. Pending Receivals are incoming material, not available on-hand inventory. Material enters Inventory when it is received.

To record a partial delivery, open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section, and choose Receive on the outstanding line. Enter Received By and the Quantity received now, then select Confirm Receive. The quantity must be positive and no greater than the remaining amount. Only that quantity enters Inventory; the balance stays pending and the existing reservation carries through. Receiving requires Inventory-receiving and business-write access. Some matching guidance is outside your current access.

sources.title: Inventory balances, reservations and receiving
sources.guidance: Viewing is distinct from mutation. Receiving additionally requires receiving permission and business-write permission; adjustments require Inventory adjustment permission and business-write permission. Reservations and movements follow existing write/RLS checks. Incoming stock is not on-hand availability. Pending Receivals represent incoming material. A receival can be unrestricted, linked to a canonical Production job, or assigned a temporary work label. Canonical and temporary reservation identities are mutually exclusive. Receiving preserves material identity, quantity history, location, pallet, notes, and reservation identity. Inventory aggregation includes reservation identity so unrestricted and job-reserved stock never merge incorrectly. Pending Receivals open collapsed with an attention-oriented count. Inventory Activity is transaction history. Catalog is a supporting reference tool.

sources.title: Purchase Order drafts, issuance, PDFs and receiving projection
sources.guidance: These are generic workflow descriptions; no live financial records or prices are included. Issued documents are immutable and PDF failure does not undo issuance. Pending Receivals creation is explicit after permanent PDF generation; incoming material does not become Inventory until receiving. Phase 1 supports New Purchase Order, draft search/filtering, structured per-line Chip or Resin classification, deterministic line totals and subtotal, save, reopen, and edit. One material-agnostic PO may contain any combination of Chip and Resin lines. The optional PO-level Production Job is a convenience default for the common single-job PO. Linking it snapshots Job Reference and Job Number, defaults a blank Date Requested from the job's requested delivery date, and assigns only currently unassigned lines. It does not overwrite deliberate dates or line assignments, so multi-job POs remain supported. Ship To, Payment Terms, and Authorized By are editable document snapshots rather than fields inferred from Production. Catalog selection proposes identity and packaging defaults without locking fields. Catalog price is labeled potentially outdated and is never applied without an operator action. Changing material preserves a manually entered price for review. Historical pricing will prefer explainable recent issued matches; no average or fabricated history is used. A saved, automatically numbered Draft may be issued after confirmation. Retrying the same revision returns the same issuance rather than producing a duplicate. Stock POs may issue without a Production Job. After issuance succeeds, the editor requests permanent PDF generation. Issuance is never rolled back when document generation fails. The issued record exposes Pending, Generating, Generated, or Failed state; Failed generation retains its error and can be retried. Generated files are opened or downloaded from the original private Storage object. After the permanent document is generated, an operator may review eligible immutable snapshot lines and project selected lines into Pending Receivals. Material, size, category, quantity, unit, ETA, and location remain reviewable operational values. ETA starts blank because the PO requested date cannot reliably prove expected material arrival. Creation is explicit, transactional, and idempotent per issuance line; previously created lines remain visible and only remaining lines can be created. Manual Pending Receival creation and receiving remain independent.

sources.title: Add or edit a Pending Receival
sources.guidance: Employees with Inventory-adjustment and business-write access can record expected incoming material. Open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section and choose + Pending Receival. Enter Vendor, Ordered By, Order Date, and at least one material line with a positive expected quantity. Add optional ETA, location, pallet or notes. For a reservation, select either an existing Production Job or a temporary work label. Choose Add Pending Receivals. Existing pending rows offer Edit and Save Changes. Expected quantity cannot be reduced below the amount already received. Pending Receivals record expectations only; material enters on-hand Inventory when someone receives it.

Open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section and choose Receive on an outstanding line. Enter Received By and Quantity received now, then Confirm Receive. Quantity must be positive and no greater than the remaining amount. Only that quantity enters Inventory; the balance stays pending and the existing reservation carries through. If the result is uncertain, keep the dialog open and retry the same quantity there. Receive selected receives the full remaining quantities of selected rows. Undo latest receipt is a separate Inventory-adjustment action and is blocked if the received stock changed.
sources.path: Inventory → Pending Receivals → Receive → Confirm Receive

sources.title: Purchase Order drafts, issuance, PDFs and receiving projection
sources.guidance: These are generic workflow descriptions; no live financial records or prices are included. Issued documents are immutable and PDF failure does not undo issuance. Pending Receivals creation is explicit after permanent PDF generation; incoming material does not become Inventory until receiving. Phase 1 supports New Purchase Order, draft search/filtering, structured per-line Chip or Resin classification, deterministic line totals and subtotal, save, reopen, and edit. One material-agnostic PO may contain any combination of Chip and Resin lines. The optional PO-level Production Job is a convenience default for the common single-job PO. Linking it snapshots Job Reference and Job Number, defaults a blank Date Requested from the job's requested delivery date, and assigns only currently unassigned lines. It does not overwrite deliberate dates or line assignments, so multi-job POs remain supported. Ship To, Payment Terms, and Authorized By are editable document snapshots rather than fields inferred from Production. Catalog selection proposes identity and packaging defaults without locking fields. Catalog price is labeled potentially outdated and is never applied without an operator action. Changing material preserves a manually entered price for review. Historical pricing will prefer explainable recent issued matches; no average or fabricated history is used. A saved, automatically numbered Draft may be issued after confirmation. Retrying the same revision returns the same issuance rather than producing a duplicate. Stock POs may issue without a Production Job. After issuance succeeds, the editor requests permanent PDF generation. Issuance is never rolled back when document generation fails. The issued record exposes Pending, Generating, Generated, or Failed state; Failed generation retains its error and can be retried. Generated files are opened or downloaded from the original private Storage object. After the permanent document is generated, an operator may review eligible immutable snapshot lines and project selected lines into Pending Receivals. Material, size, category, quantity, unit, ETA, and location remain reviewable operational values. ETA starts blank because the PO requested date cannot reliably prove expected material arrival. Creation is explicit, transactional, and idempotent per issuance line; previously created lines remain visible and only remaining lines can be created. Manual Pending Receival creation and receiving remain independent.

sources.title: Add or edit a Pending Receival
sources.guidance: Employees with Inventory-adjustment and business-write access can record expected incoming material. Open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section and choose + Pending Receival. Enter Vendor, Ordered By, Order Date, and at least one material line with a positive expected quantity. Add optional ETA, location, pallet or notes. For a reservation, select either an existing Production Job or a temporary work label. Choose Add Pending Receivals. Existing pending rows offer Edit and Save Changes. Expected quantity cannot be reduced below the amount already received. Pending Receivals record expectations only; material enters on-hand Inventory when someone receives it.
sources.path: Inventory → Pending Receivals → + Pending Receival → Add Pending Receivals

sources.title: Inventory balances, reservations and receiving
sources.guidance: Viewing is distinct from mutation. Receiving additionally requires receiving permission and business-write permission; adjustments require Inventory adjustment permission and business-write permission. Reservations and movements follow existing write/RLS checks. Incoming stock is not on-hand availability. Pending Receivals represent incoming material. A receival can be unrestricted, linked to a canonical Production job, or assigned a temporary work label. Canonical and temporary reservation identities are mutually exclusive. final.answer:
No. Issuing the PO does not increase on-hand stock; material enters Inventory when it is received.

For a short delivery, receive only the quantity that actually arrived: open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section, and choose Receive on the outstanding line. Enter Received By and Quantity received now, then choose Confirm Receive. The remaining balance stays pending. Avoid Receive selected for a partial receipt, because it receives the full remaining quantities of selected rows.

If there is no pending receival yet, PO lines can be projected into Pending Receivals after the permanent PDF is generated; that creation is explicit. Receiving requires Inventory-receiving and business-write access. Some matching guidance is outside your current access, so there may be additional steps I cannot see.

sources.title: Record labor in Manpower Reporting
sources.guidance: Employees with business-write access can record labor. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting. Clear search, Job and product filters before creating an empty group. Clear filters before changing a whole group’s Job.
sources.path: Reporting → Manpower Reporting → New Group or Add New Line → Add Entry

sources.guidance: Employees with business-write access can record stock movements. Open Inventory → Current Inventory → Record Stock. Choose Intake or Outtake, enter Your Name and material lines with positive quantities, units and matching lot details, then Record Intake Lines or Record Outtake Lines. arguments.query: Pending Receivals on hand inventory partial delivery

final.answer:
No. Pending Receivals are incoming material, not available on-hand inventory. Material enters Inventory when it is received.

To record a partial delivery, open Inventory → Pending Receivals, expand the section, and choose Receive on the outstanding line. Enter Received By and the Quantity received now, then select Confirm Receive. The quantity must be positive and no greater than the remaining amount. Only that quantity enters Inventory; the balance stays pending and the existing reservation carries through. Receiving requires Inventory-receiving and business-write access. Some matching guidance is outside your current access.

Enter Received By and Quantity received now, then choose Confirm Receive. The remaining balance stays pending. Avoid Receive selected for a partial receipt, because it receives the full remaining quantities of selected rows.

If there is no pending receival yet, PO lines can be projected into Pending Receivals after the permanent PDF is generated; that creation is explicit. arguments.query: Manpower Reporting default ordering groups rows sort Job name

final.answer:
By default, groups are collapsed and ordered by reporting date, newest first. Groups without a valid leading date follow. Within an expanded group, rows are ordered by Work Date, newest first.

To sort groups by Job name, select Sort groups → Job name, A–Z. Mixed-Job groups use their alphabetically first Job or work label; empty groups follow. The order can change while older groups load.
